title: run
description: The declared-command escape hatch (SDD 9.6). Executes one command from the merged config's [commands] table as a single argv — no shell, ever. Commands are seeded at init from lockfile/manifest detection, amendable only by a human (workbench.toml is a protected path), and governable by org policy (7.2). Known runners (bun/jest/vitest/pytest/cargo test/cargo nextest/go) get structured failure extraction (test name, file, assertion, trimmed trace) via bundled runner adapters; cargo build/check/clippy (and a test run that failed to compile) get a diagnostics row (level, code, message, file:line:column, help) from rustc's JSON or its rendered output, errors first, trimmed to the budget with a manifest; unknown commands get head+tail with a truncation manifest. An undeclared command answers COMMAND_NOT_DECLARED; munging or shell attempts answer RUN_REDIRECTED with a redirect to search/edit.

command.description: The declared command key from the [commands] table, e.g. "test".

args.description: Extra argv appended to the declared command line, e.g. ["--filter", "auth"]. Passed literally — shell operators are rejected, never interpreted.

timeout.description: Wall-clock limit in seconds. A timeout kills the process and returns partial output as data (timedOut: true), not an error.
